name: Calf Raise

instructions.description: Stand tall with feet parallel and support nearby.
Rise onto the balls of the feet without rolling the ankles outward.
Lower the heels slowly to the starting position.

performanceMetrics.notes: Use a consistent reviewer-defined quality scale for control and alignment.

variations.variationDescription: Calf Raise — Tempo-Controlled Version: Use a deliberately slower lowering phase without creating a separate database record.
Calf Raise — Reduced-Range Version: Use a smaller comfortable range while preserving the same movement pattern.

commentsNotes: Light fingertip support can be used.
